note_tweet.text:
A Georgia police officer shoots and kills a beloved 1-year-old miniature donkey named HeeHaw as the animal approaches officers searching a farm for a missing child.

Newly released bodycam footage shows the small donkey moving toward officers before one attempts to use a Taser and another opens fire. HeeHaw runs away before collapsing in the field.

The officer claims the donkey was charging at police, but his devastated owner insists HeeHaw was simply approaching people the way he always did.

The officer is on administrative leave as state investigators examine the shooting.

BREAKING: WTF! Trump inexplicably shares violent animal videos on social media as calls for the 25TH AMENDMENT grow louder.

It’s the kind of behavior that, if your grandpa did it, you’d start calling around to find a nursing home that specializes in patients with severe dementia.

But since it’s Donald Trump, the putative president of the United States, the only consequence for his latest display of a mind gone horribly off the deep end will be a few snarky comments on social media, instead of the invocation of the 25th Amendment that it deserves.

The behavior in question is the posting of a series of videos that depict large lions and tigers attacking and mauling human beings, as if these tragic incidents are just a source of amusement for Trump’s addled brain.

The first video, taken at a wildlife park in England, depicts a tiger pawing, batting around, biting, and mauling a man on the grass in an enclosure. Posted without any detail or context about the attack, the video is only described by Trump’s caption: “Don’t ever mess with nature! President DJT”. 

It’s a laughable admonishment, given every offense that Trump has committed against nature while he’s been in office, from selling off public land to energy giants to exploit as they wish to eliminating regulations designed to protect the air we breathe and the water we drink to eliminating government subsidies for the adoption of solar power and electric vehicles. Not to mention his claims that human-induced climate change is a massive hoax.

Otherwise, the reasons for the post are just as indecipherable as the next video he put up on Truth Social, this one a 24-second montage of lions viciously attacking men, this one sans any caption whatsoever to provide insight as to why the hell he’s wasting his time posting this crap on the internet instead of doing his job as president.

Then again, given what a piss-poor job he’s doing as chief executive, perhaps we should be glad that he’s doing this instead of attacking Cuba or amping up the war in Iran.

But, seriously, if this kind of behavior doesn’t lead you to believe that Dementia Donnie is unfit for office at this point, then you’re probably an unrepentant MAGA zombie who’ll never abandon Trump no matter how bizarre his actions become.

Please like and share if you’re not one of those zombies.
